input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no limitation of liability, exclusion of damages or aggregate-liability language anywhere: the Warranties section (9) contains only reps and the Globix acknowledgement, the Confidentiality section (8) has no liability limit, and the General Provisions (10.1–10.8) address notices, no joint venture, assignment, waiver, governing law, severability, survival, entire agreement and headings only. Searches for "liability", "consequential damages", "indemnify" and warranty disclaimers return no cap or exclusion. Both parties are therefore fully exposed at law, which fails the rule entirely. We insert the fallback position as a new Section 10.9: a mutual cap at twelve months' fees with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap. We have not pursued the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor, data protection/security and fraud carve-outs or the payment-obligations exclusion, which can be raised in negotiation but are not required at fallback.

ops.text: Limitation of Liability. Except for each Party's indemnification obligations, breach of its confidentiality obligations, gross negligence or wilful misconduct, which are not subject to any limitation, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no limitation of liability, so we have added our fallback position: a mutual cap set at the fees payable in the twelve months preceding the claim, with indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and wilful misconduct sitting outside the cap.
proposal.summary: Insert a mutual liability cap of 12 months' fees with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
